head: Salon app turns Apple TV into an art frame with museum paintings
dek: Salon is an Apple TV app that keeps one picture on your TV screen like a frame on the wall: over 1,000 open-access museum paintings, or your own photos from iCloud. It costs 9.99 dollars once, with no subscription mentioned.
details: Its developer, Rene Haavre, says every picture was checked by hand and cut to 3840 x 2160, so the TV neither crops nor letterboxes it. Galleries run from the Renaissance to Impressionism and Ukiyo-e, plus space, Earth from above, early colour photos and old maps. Photos can fill the screen or sit inside a border, and a clock and date can show in a corner. The developer built it to work like the art mode of Samsung's Frame TV.
where: Apple TV with tvOS 17 or later, 9.99 dollars on the App Store
means: If your TV sits black most of the day, Salon gives it something to show without a monthly fee.
todo: Search for Salon: Museum Art Frame in the App Store on your Apple TV.
thumb_words: APPLE TV BECOMES AN ART FRAME
